name: Reduced root system
description: A root system in which for every root alpha the only scalar multiples of alpha that are also roots are alpha and -alpha (i.e. 2*alpha is never a root).

name: Existence of Cartan subalgebras
description: Every finite-dimensional Lie algebra over an infinite field possesses a Cartan subalgebra, obtained as the generalized zero-eigenspace (nilspace) of ad(X) for a regular element X.

name: Compact Lie algebra
description: A real Lie algebra that admits an Ad-invariant positive-definite inner product, equivalently the Lie algebra of a compact Lie group.

name: Negative-definiteness of the Killing form on a compact semisimple Lie algebra
description: A real semisimple Lie algebra is the Lie algebra of a compact group if and only if its Killing form is negative definite.

name: Weyl's theorem on finiteness of the fundamental group
description: The fundamental group of a compact semisimple Lie group is finite, and consequently its universal covering group is again compact.
aliases: compactness of the universal cover of a compact semisimple group

name: Surjectivity of the exponential map for compact connected Lie groups
description: For a compact connected Lie group the exponential map exp: g -> G is surjective, so every element lies on a one-parameter subgroup and hence in a maximal torus.

name: Conjugation relative to a real form
description: The conjugate-linear involution of a complex Lie algebra g^C that fixes exactly a given real form g_0, satisfying tau([X,Y]) = [tau X, tau Y] and tau(zX) = conj(z) tau(X).
aliases: conjugation with respect to a real form

name: Existence of a compact real form
description: Every complex semisimple Lie algebra possesses a compact real form, namely a real form whose Killing form is negative definite.

name: Uniqueness of the compact real form up to conjugacy
description: Any two compact real forms of a complex semisimple Lie algebra are conjugate by an inner automorphism of the complex algebra.

name: Complexification of a compact Lie group
description: The unique connected complex Lie group G^C containing a compact Lie group U as a maximal compact subgroup, with Lie algebra g^C = u (+) iu and U^C-representations corresponding bijectively to U-representations.
aliases: universal complexification of a compact group

name: Existence of a Cartan involution
description: Every real semisimple Lie algebra admits a Cartan involution, i.e. an involutive automorphism theta for which B_theta(X,Y) = -B(X, theta Y) is positive definite.

name: Conjugacy of Cartan involutions
description: Any two Cartan involutions of a real semisimple Lie algebra are conjugate by an inner automorphism, so the maximal compact subalgebra k is unique up to conjugacy.

name: Borel-Weil theorem
description: For a compact connected Lie group with complexification G^C and Borel subgroup B, the space of holomorphic sections of the line bundle L_lambda over the flag manifold G^C/B associated to a dominant integral weight lambda realizes the irreducible representation of highest weight lambda.

name: Reductive Lie group (Knapp's class)
description: A 4-tuple (G,K,theta,B) consisting of a Lie group G with a global Cartan involution theta, maximal compact subgroup K = G^theta, and a nondegenerate Ad(G)-invariant theta-invariant bilinear form B on g, with g reductive, satisfying Knapp's structural axioms (closure conditions making G of Harish-Chandra class).
aliases: reductive group in the sense of Knapp

name: Cartan subalgebra of a real semisimple Lie algebra
description: A maximal abelian subalgebra h of a real semisimple Lie algebra g whose adjoint action is everywhere semisimple over the complexification, equivalently a real form of a Cartan subalgebra of g^C.

name: Theta-stable Cartan subalgebra
description: A Cartan subalgebra h of a real semisimple Lie algebra invariant under a fixed Cartan involution theta, hence decomposing as h = (h ∩ k) (+) (h ∩ p) into its compact (toral) and noncompact (vector) parts.

name: Existence of a theta-stable Cartan subalgebra
description: Every Cartan subalgebra of a real semisimple Lie algebra is conjugate by an inner automorphism to a theta-stable one, so theta-stable Cartan subalgebras always exist and represent every conjugacy class.

name: Maximally compact and maximally noncompact Cartan subalgebras
description: Among theta-stable Cartan subalgebras of a real semisimple Lie algebra, the maximally compact one has its toral part h ∩ k of maximal dimension and the maximally noncompact (split, or fundamental for the noncompact case) one has h ∩ p of maximal dimension equal to the real rank.

name: Finiteness of conjugacy classes of Cartan subalgebras
description: A real semisimple Lie algebra has only finitely many conjugacy classes of Cartan subalgebras, all obtained from a maximally noncompact one by successive Cayley transforms.

name: Real, imaginary, and complex roots
description: For a theta-stable Cartan subalgebra h = t (+) a of a real semisimple Lie algebra, a root is imaginary if it vanishes on a, real if it vanishes on t, and complex otherwise, classifying roots by their behavior under the Cartan involution.

name: Compact and noncompact imaginary roots
description: An imaginary root (one fixed by theta) is compact if its root space lies in k^C and noncompact if its root space lies in p^C, distinguishing the two types needed for Vogan diagrams and Cayley transforms.

name: Vogan diagram
description: The Dynkin diagram of a complex semisimple Lie algebra decorated by an involution (arrows) coming from a maximally compact theta-stable Cartan subalgebra together with painted vertices marking the noncompact imaginary simple roots, encoding a real form up to isomorphism.

name: Vogan diagram theorem
description: Every Vogan diagram arises from a real form of a complex semisimple Lie algebra, two real forms are isomorphic iff their diagrams are equivalent, and applying the Borel-de Siebenthal procedure brings any Vogan diagram to a normalized form with at most one painted vertex.

name: Borel-de Siebenthal theorem
description: The maximal-rank reductive (regular) subalgebras of a compact semisimple Lie algebra are classified, up to conjugacy, by deleting one node from the extended (affine) Dynkin diagram; equivalently it normalizes Vogan diagrams to have at most one painted simple root.

name: Maximal abelian subspace a of p
description: A maximal abelian subspace a of the (-1)-eigenspace p of a Cartan involution on a real semisimple Lie algebra; all such subspaces are Ad(K)-conjugate and their common dimension is the real rank.

name: Real rank of G
description: The dimension of a maximal abelian subspace a of p, equivalently the rank of the restricted root system and the dimension of the vector group A in the Iwasawa decomposition.

name: Restricted roots
description: The nonzero weights of the adjoint action of a maximal abelian subspace a of p on a real semisimple Lie algebra, i.e. the nonzero linear functionals lambda on a with g_lambda = {X : [H,X] = lambda(H)X for all H in a} nonzero.

name: Restricted root space decomposition
description: A real semisimple Lie algebra decomposes as g = g_0 (+) sum over restricted roots lambda of g_lambda, where g_0 = m (+) a is the centralizer of a and g_lambda are the restricted root spaces.

name: Restricted root multiplicity
description: The dimension m_lambda = dim g_lambda of the restricted root space attached to a restricted root lambda, which (unlike for ordinary roots) may exceed one.

name: Restricted root system Sigma
description: The set of restricted roots of a real semisimple Lie algebra forms an abstract root system Sigma in a*, possibly non-reduced (of type BC), with Weyl group W(Sigma).

name: Centralizer m = Z_k(a)
description: The centralizer of a maximal abelian subspace a in the maximal compact subalgebra k, equal to the compact part of the zero restricted root space g_0 = m (+) a.

name: M = Z_K(a)
description: The centralizer of a in the maximal compact subgroup K, a compact (possibly disconnected) subgroup with Lie algebra m, appearing as the reductive factor of the minimal parabolic subgroup P = MAN.
aliases: M = centralizer of A in K

name: Positivity and ordering of restricted roots
function_signature: (maximal abelian subspace a) → (choice of positive restricted roots Sigma+)
description: Fixes a lexicographic (or chamber-based) ordering on a* to select a system of positive restricted roots, thereby determining the nilpotent subalgebra n in the Iwasawa decomposition.

name: Nilpotent subalgebra n
description: The nilpotent Lie subalgebra n = sum over positive restricted roots lambda of g_lambda associated to a choice of positivity, which is the n-factor of the Iwasawa decomposition g = k (+) a (+) n.

name: Iwasawa decomposition of the Lie algebra
description: A real semisimple Lie algebra splits as a vector-space direct sum g = k (+) a (+) n, where k is maximal compact, a is a maximal abelian subspace of p, and n is the sum of positive restricted root spaces.

name: Iwasawa decomposition G = KAN
description: A connected semisimple Lie group factors as G = KAN with K maximal compact, A = exp(a) a simply connected abelian (vector) group, and N = exp(n) simply connected nilpotent.

name: Uniqueness in the Iwasawa decomposition
description: The multiplication map K × A × N -> G is a diffeomorphism, so every group element g = kan has uniquely determined factors k in K, a in A, n in N.

name: A = exp(a) vector group
description: The analytic subgroup A = exp(a) of a semisimple Lie group, a simply connected abelian Lie group isomorphic to R^r (r the real rank) on which exp: a -> A is a diffeomorphism.

name: N = exp(n) nilpotent group
description: The analytic subgroup N = exp(n) of a semisimple Lie group, a simply connected nilpotent Lie group on which exp: n -> N is a diffeomorphism, normalized by A.

name: Weyl group of the restricted root system W(Sigma)
description: The Weyl group generated by reflections in the restricted roots, acting on a* and permuting the restricted-root chambers.

name: W(Sigma) = N_K(a)/Z_K(a)
description: The Weyl group of the restricted root system is realized analytically as the quotient N_K(a)/Z_K(a) of the normalizer of a in K by its centralizer.

name: KAK (Cartan/polar) decomposition
description: A connected semisimple Lie group satisfies G = K A K, more precisely G = K cl(A+) K with the A+-part of each element unique up to the Weyl group W(Sigma); equivalently G = K exp(p) refined to G = K (exp cl(a+)) K.

name: Closed positive Weyl chamber a+ and A+
description: The closed chamber cl(a+) = {H in a : lambda(H) >= 0 for all positive restricted roots lambda} and the corresponding A+ = exp(cl(a+)), a fundamental domain for W(Sigma) parametrizing the radial part in the KAK decomposition.

name: Minimal parabolic subgroup P = MAN
description: The minimal parabolic subgroup P = MAN of a semisimple Lie group, with M = Z_K(a), A = exp(a), and N the Iwasawa nilpotent group, having Langlands decomposition MA.N.

name: Standard parabolic subgroups from subsets of simple restricted roots
description: The parabolic subgroups of a real reductive group containing a fixed minimal parabolic P = MAN are parametrized, up to conjugacy, by subsets of the simple restricted roots, generalizing the algebraic-group classification by subsets of simple roots.

name: Langlands decomposition of a parabolic
description: Every parabolic subgroup of a real reductive group factors canonically as P = M_P A_P N_P, where M_P A_P is the Levi factor (M_P reductive, A_P a split central vector group) and N_P is the unipotent radical.
aliases: Levi decomposition of a real parabolic

name: Iwasawa projection H(g)
description: The a-valued function H: G -> a defined by writing g = k exp(H(g)) n in the Iwasawa decomposition G = KAN, central to spherical functions and the theory of Eisenstein series.

name: Half-sum of positive restricted roots rho
description: The element rho = (1/2) sum over positive restricted roots lambda of m_lambda * lambda in a*, weighted by restricted-root multiplicities, governing the modular function of MAN and the Jacobian of the Iwasawa integration.

name: Integral formula for the KAN decomposition
description: A Haar integral over G expressed in Iwasawa coordinates g = kan reads ∫_G f = c ∫_K ∫_A ∫_N f(kan) e^{2 rho(log a)} dn da dk, with the exponential factor coming from the half-sum of positive restricted roots.

name: Integral formula for the KAK decomposition
description: A Haar integral over G in polar coordinates g = k1 (exp H) k2 reads ∫_G f = c ∫_K ∫_{a+} ∫_K f(k1 exp(H) k2) J(H) dk1 dH dk2 with Jacobian J(H) = prod over positive restricted roots (sinh lambda(H))^{m_lambda}.

name: Integral formula over the symmetric space G/K
description: Integration over the symmetric space G/K in geodesic polar coordinates about the base point reads ∫_{G/K} f = c ∫_K ∫_{a+} f(k exp(H) o) prod (sinh lambda(H))^{m_lambda} dH dk.

name: Non-unimodularity of AN
description: The solvable group AN (and the minimal parabolic MAN) is non-unimodular, with modular function Delta(an) = e^{2 rho(log a)} given by the half-sum of positive restricted roots.

name: Unimodularity of semisimple and reductive groups
description: Every semisimple (and every reductive in Knapp's class) Lie group is unimodular, so its left Haar measure is also right-invariant.

name: Hermitian symmetric space
description: A Riemannian symmetric space carrying a G-invariant complex structure compatible with the metric (making it a Kahler manifold whose symmetries are holomorphic isometries).
aliases: Hermitian symmetric space of noncompact/compact type

name: Criterion for Hermitian type
description: An irreducible symmetric space G/K of noncompact type is Hermitian if and only if the center Z(k) of the maximal compact subalgebra is nonzero (one-dimensional), the central element inducing the invariant complex structure.

name: Bounded symmetric domain
description: A bounded domain in C^n that is symmetric, i.e. at each point admits a holomorphic involutive isometry fixing that point isolatedly; these are exactly the Hermitian symmetric spaces of noncompact type.

name: Harish-Chandra decomposition g^C = p- + k^C + p+
description: For a Hermitian symmetric pair, the complexification splits as g^C = p- (+) k^C (+) p+ where p+ and p- are abelian subalgebras (the (+i) and (-i) eigenspaces of the complex structure) normalized by k^C.

name: Harish-Chandra embedding
description: The map G/K -> p+ given by g K -> the p+-component of log in the decomposition G^C subset P- K^C P+ realizes a Hermitian symmetric space of noncompact type as a bounded symmetric domain in the complex vector space p+.

name: Strongly orthogonal roots
description: A set of roots that are pairwise orthogonal and whose pairwise sums and differences are never roots; a maximal such set of noncompact positive roots yields polydisc/polysphere coordinates and computes the rank of a Hermitian symmetric space.

name: Kostant's linear convexity theorem
description: For a connected semisimple Lie group, the image under the Iwasawa a-projection H(.) of the orbit Ad(K)X of an element X in a equals the convex hull of the Weyl-group orbit W·X in a.

name: Opposite nilpotent subalgebra n-bar = theta(n)
description: The nilpotent subalgebra n-bar = theta(n) = sum over negative restricted roots of g_lambda, the image of n under the Cartan involution, giving the opposite (lower-triangular) unipotent radical.

name: Open Bruhat cell (big cell)
description: The dense open subset N-bar M A N of a semisimple Lie group (the big Bruhat cell corresponding to the longest Weyl element), on which N-bar -> G/P is an open embedding, giving generic coordinates on the flag manifold.

name: G-invariant metric on G/K from B_theta
description: The G-invariant Riemannian metric on the symmetric space G/K obtained by transporting the inner product B_theta restricted to p ≅ T_o(G/K), making G/K a symmetric space of noncompact type.

name: Curvature formula R(X,Y)Z = -[[X,Y],Z]
description: On a symmetric space G/K with tangent space p, the Riemann curvature tensor at the base point is R(X,Y)Z = -[[X,Y],Z] for X,Y,Z in p, expressing curvature purely through the Lie bracket.

name: Siegel domain (tube domain) realization
description: An unbounded realization of a bounded symmetric domain as a Siegel domain of type I (tube domain over a symmetric cone) or type II, biholomorphic to the domain via a Cayley-type transform.

name: Cayley transform (Lie-theoretic)
function_signature: (theta-stable Cartan subalgebra h, noncompact imaginary or real root alpha) → (new theta-stable Cartan subalgebra)
description: The inner automorphism c_alpha = Ad(exp((pi/4)(X_alpha - X_{-alpha}))) built from a noncompact root, which interchanges compact and noncompact directions of a Cartan subalgebra and relates different conjugacy classes of theta-stable Cartan subalgebras.
aliases: Cayley transform of a Cartan subalgebra

name: Harish-Chandra projection (rho-shift)
description: Projects the center of the universal enveloping algebra onto U(h) ≅ S(h) along the triangular decomposition U(g) = (n- U(g) + U(g) n+) (+) U(h) and then twists by the rho-shift to land in the W-invariants, giving the Harish-Chandra isomorphism.
